note: Material 3 standard motion scheme, from the token constants in androidx.compose.material3 (StandardMotionTokens, v0.14). The calmer sibling of the expressive scheme: spatial springs are nearly critically damped (ratio 0.9) so they barely overshoot; effects springs are identical to the expressive scheme's. Common names: standard = spatial-default, quick = spatial-fast, gentle = spatial-slow, playful = spatial-default (this scheme has no bouncier spring), fade = effects-default.

playful.note: = spatial-default; this scheme has nothing bouncier
